set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 3. Implement the Phase-0-selected applicative encoding for typed logical value slots and pure inspectable DecodePlan[ResponseBlock], starting with temporal DCT or Haar, and execute it through an in-memory logical-payload interpreter from output-domain selections. Define ReconstructionContract for scientific fidelity and a separate representation-specific DecodeConsistency for selected, partitioned, ordered, and backend paths. Acceptance: selection, partition, ordering, shape, and domain laws use DecodeConsistency; encode/decode alone uses ReconstructionContract; plans are inspectable; coefficient and basis values cannot be exchanged; independent reads collect without casts, Any, strings, or a universal Tensor type; the frozen numerical corpus remains green on JVM and Scala.js.
